arguments.name: url
arguments.description: base URL of the API, such as https://staging.example.com

description: Compare the contract with a running API and say which side needs fixing
name: check_live

arguments.name: sample
arguments.description: the JSON response the API returned

description: Turn a real API response into a route with states
name: draft_from_sample

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: git ref to compare from, such as main; the last commit when left out

description: Explain contract changes for a pull request: what breaks and who needs to act
name: explain_diff

arguments.name: route
arguments.description: one route id, such as users.get; every route when left out

description: Find the states apps still need, such as errors, empty lists and slow responses, and add them
name: suggest_states
